sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice B. P. Sharma

On The 4 th Of November, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 7889 of 2018
 Anoop Singh Markam
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri
 Shri
 Order
Custody report of the appellant has been received from Superintendent of District Jail, Mandla dated 29-10-2025

reflects that appellant - Anoop Singh Markam has served the entire jail sentence as awarded by the trial Court in Special Case No. 111/2015 U/ss. 376(2) and 506-B of IPC and U/s 5 r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
As per the report the appellant has been released on 23-09-2023 from the District Jail, Mandla after completion of his jail sentence as awarded the learned trial Court.
Since the sole appellant has already been released from jail after completing the jail sentence, this appeal is rendered infructuous.
It is accordingly disposed off having rendered infructuous.
Let copy of this order be order along with record of the trial court be sent to the concerned trial court for information and necessary compliance.

(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE PG Anoop Singh Markam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132702564/
